_readme: FIRST SLICE text inputs for tools3d/spaces_glb.py — the game's prop list, one entry per mesh. Run from the repo root: python tools3d/spaces_glb.py --manifest tools3d/spaces_manifest.json. Each entry becomes <out-dir>/<name>.glb + <name>.concept.png + <name>.meta.json. Optional per-entry keys: 'space' (hunyuan3d | hunyuan3d-21 | hunyuan3d-mv | trellis-community | trellis-2 — omit to walk the auto fallback chain), 'image' (path to a reference image instead of 'text'), 'seed'. Prompts follow the Art Bible: cozy lowpoly, warm palette, clean background so server-side background removal can find the object.
